title: aperiodic-settling
description: The condition that a settling never converges to a countable fixed point: its closure ordinal satisfies kappa >= omega_1, so the orbit is strictly knowledge-ascending and coherent rather than stabilizing, and its invariants escape fixed-point theorems. Generated by qualifying a settling by the size of its closure ordinal.

settling.description: the predication settling this condition qualifies

closureOrdinal.description: the least ordinal kappa at which the settling endofunctor reaches a fixed point

aperiodic.description: kappa >= omega_1: no countable ordinal is a strict fixed point; the orbit ascends strictly in <=_k and carries all 2-cell information of the KZ diamond, with invariants not accessible via fixed-point theorems (unlike a converged sheaf, where H^1 = 0)
